items.text: Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith officially off injury report, good to go MNF vs Bears. Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.why: Barkley stinger cleared after full practices; Smith hamstring full. Rapoport confirms.
items.implication: Full workload expected in plus matchup; reverse any prior backup beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Barkley usual snaps/carries/RZ; Smith clear top WR targets vs porous CHI secondary.

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT for Sunday (hamstring). Corroborated as ruled out by Schefter/Rapoport.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practice, official OUT on ETR Sunday list and Schefter report.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in HOU offense; Schultz and other pass-catchers elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Dalton Schultz (~30% share prior absence) and remaining WRs.

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT (toe). Jaylen Warren projected lead with checkdown volume boost per Levitan.
items.why: Toe injury; Steelers ruled out, coach: Warren leads group.
items.implication: Warren clear lead back + receiving work vs CIN; backups Homer/Heidenreich.
items.opportunity: Warren snaps/carries/routes/checkdowns expand significantly; vertical pass game struggling.

items.text: Puka Nacua DOUBTFUL (hip); not expected to play Sunday per Rapoport/McVay. Possible return next week.
items.why: Hip/groin; DNP all week, McVay hopeful next week vs PHI barring setback.
items.implication: Adams carries load; other Rams WRs/TE elevated for SNF vs DEN.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams target/route share spikes; secondary options like Whittington.

items.text: Broncos RB Jonah Coleman to short-term IR with high-ankle sprain; miss next few games, back ~Week 7 vs ARI. Dobbins/Harvey IN/good to go.
items.why: High-ankle from Week 2; official IR placement.
items.implication: Clearer short-term RB committee for DEN; safer starts for Dobbins/Harvey.
items.opportunity: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey snap/carry share expand vs LAR.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams ruled OUT MNF vs Eagles (hamstring). Tyson Bagent full practice, officially Q.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP week, official ruling. Bagent returning from concussion.
items.implication: Backup QB (Bagent/Keenum) starts; negative for CHI pass-catchers vs stout PHI D.
items.opportunity: Limited upside for Odunze/Burden/Loveland; streaming caution.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow). Positive longer-term notes (not IR, Mariota starts) per Rapoport.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow; official OUT, Mariota starts vs SEA.
items.implication: Commanders offense downgraded; McLaurin/others face tough SEA matchup with backup QB.
items.opportunity: Mariota stream if desperate; watch for Daniels return timeline.

items.text: Alec Pierce OUT; Jonathon Brooks OUT (core, IR timeline). Beneficiaries Downs (role expand) and Hubbard (lead back).
items.why: Pierce heel; Brooks core surgery 6-8 weeks.
items.implication: Downs perimeter + target bump; Hubbard firm lead RB vs CLE.
items.opportunity: Josh Downs routes/targets rise; Chuba Hubbard snap/rush/target share spikes.

items.text: IN: JK Dobbins, RJ Harvey (Coleman out), Malik Nabers, Travis Etienne, Jadarian Price. Qs include Bowers/Flowers/Evans/Warren/Pittman projected mostly in by Levitan.
items.why: ETR comprehensive Sunday list; Levitan projecting key Qs active.
items.implication: Clarify starts; reverse stale benches for these actives.
items.opportunity: Dobbins/Harvey committee work; Nabers/Etienne full roles; monitor Q clarity early.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren leads Steelers RBs; expect heavy checkdowns as vertical game failed. Projecting Warren (and Evans/Bowers) in despite Q tags. Gibbs ceiling record 44.0.
items.why: Coach comments + usage data; checkdown spam likely. Sims show Gibbs elite ceiling home vs NYJ.
items.implication: Warren strong RB2/flex; Gibbs smash play; Qs (Warren/Evans/Bowers) projected active.
items.opportunity: Warren lead carries + routes/checkdowns; Gibbs massive snap/carry/target share.

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high YPR to WRs) and Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% share w/ Collins out; IND 4th-most yds to TEs).
items.why: Usage data + matchup; Schultz boosted by Collins absence.
items.implication: Olave WR2/WR1 upside; Schultz TE1/stream smash.
items.opportunity: Olave routes/targets/air yards; Schultz target share spike.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5), DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup and prop line signal heavy volume/workload.
items.implication: Strong RB1 start; feed him in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: High carries/RZ opportunity vs weak run D.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games, RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush ypg to RBs.
items.why: Proven early volume + favorable rush matchup.
items.implication: RB2 with upside; lock in lineups.

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% RB touches, 38% 3rd-down snaps), Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; tough JAX run D), Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest FP to WRs, low team total).
items.why: Poor recent usage/roles + tough matchups/low totals.
items.implication: Sit/fade; look elsewhere for RB/WR slots.
items.opportunity: Etienne role limited despite IN; Stevenson post-fumble demotion; McLaurin suppressed volume.
items.conflict: ETR has Etienne IN but Berry flags usage concerns.
